SELECT SUBSTRING(T2."XCL_020", 1, 4)
FROM customers AS T1
INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1."XCL_001" = T2."XCL_019"
WHERE T1."XCL_003" = 'EUR'
GROUP BY SUBSTRING(T2."XCL_020", 1, 4)
ORDER BY SUM(T2."XCL_021") DESC
LIMIT 1

    strftime('%Y', t.XCL_011) AS year
FROM 
    transactions_1k t
JOIN 
    customers c ON t.XCL_013 = c.XCL_001
JOIN 
    gasstations g ON t.XCL_014 = g.XCL_004
WHERE 
    g.XCL_007 = 'Czech Republic'
    AND t.XCL_012 = 'EUR'
GROUP BY 
    strftime('%Y', t.XCL_011)
ORDER BY 
    SUM(t.XCL_018) DESC
LIMIT 1
